name: cfcmt-bus-entropy-free-continuation-v1

evaluation.test_separation: Predefined before new training or evaluation; disjoint from fit/stop/calibration, smoke and all previous evaluation cohorts. Same pinned services and generated OD intensities.
evaluation.comparison: 48 actual fresh evaluations: OFF two arms18, prior IQL ON two arms18, adapted55k9, rule3.
evaluation.completion: Report completion rate and departed/completed counts alongside cost.
evaluation.interpretation: Bounded pilot on one target city; no population-level CI or city removal.

asset_selection.ordering: Original route, direction, pattern and service id, before any control outcomes
asset_selection.network: GTFS-derived route corridors; APC-apportioned demand, generated destinations; not a measured city road network
asset_selection.calendar_rule: Earliest weekday in the pinned GTFS feed with active weekday service and without a holiday exception; keep the original 12-service subset
asset_selection.calendar_provenance: Actual trip_id/service_id and full stop signatures from GTFS; never merge mutually exclusive calendar services or clamp zero scheduled headways

checkpoint_rule: New OFF actors use fixed final20k policies; current ON references use their existing fixed final20k. Adapted55k is fewer-update stage reference. No seed/checkpoint selection.
intervention: Only config.backup_entropy changes from True to False within the already execution-projected recorded-IQL actor continuation. Same physical Q sampling, original H2O+ value/Q mixing, actor likelihood, V and temperature updates, model generation/trust and original replay.
boundary: A single TD-target objective intervention after recorded-IQL actor repair. Static decomposition motivates the hypothesis, but new fixed-final closed-loop results must determine whether training and cost improve. Does not isolate source contribution or normalized confidence.
limits: One fixed target-city timetable and generated OD intensities; three fresh random realizations do not establish cross-city generality.
Static OFF residuals did not repair the existing critics; all new training starts from the original55k.
Adapted55k has fewer updates; model0/0.25 does not isolate normalized confidence or source contribution.
No entropy coefficient, temperature, threshold, model, city, seed or checkpoint selection after outcomes.
code_boundary: CFCMT-owned frozen runtime and inputs only; no mutable Thesis access; no H5/CSV/checkpoint downloads.
fixed_training: Six new20k continuations reset from the original seed-matched adapted55k learner and optimizers, not from the entropy-ON final damaged critics. Recorded IQL actor remains fixed as the method; real/model coefficient0/0.25. Only entropy in real and model TD bootstrap is removed. Existing temperature algorithm and random draws remain, even though alpha no longer enters the target. No new training simulator events.
entropy_interpretation: SAC latent-temperature sampling/update is retained only as the frozen algorithm path. Actor uses recorded likelihood, and alpha is excluded from real/model TD targets. No estimate of execution-action entropy is added.
admission: Four steps per TD0/0.25 entropyON/OFF arm from same adapted seed75101: original replay and RNG, actor/V/alpha update counts; initial actor/V/alpha equal. All actual OFF real/model targets invariant to an alpha change at fixed networks and common draws; only critic target/loss may differ.
reporting_interpretation: 48 actual evaluations on prospective demand72541-72543/SUMO73541-73543: entropyOFF18, prior IQL entropyON18, adapted55k9, rule3. All seeds/final artifacts retained, equal seed/case weights, no old-case pooling or population CI.
actor_objective: Existing _update_iql_actor: negative mean detached IQL weight times raw recorded-action log likelihood; advantage temperature3 and max weight100. No extra coefficient, replay sampling, label projection, hard data-support bound or new V update.
temperature_interpretation: The SAC latent-temperature sample retains its original pre-actor-step position and random draws; alpha optimizer updates remain after the actor step. Alpha trajectories may diverge as actors diverge; no freeze, clamp or retuning.
